name: so101_reach_mujoco_warp_wall_clock_v0
description: Wall-clock SO-101 follower reach benchmark using a MuJoCo Warp batched training collector and CPU MuJoCo reference eval.
notes: Use with seed_trainable_vectorized.py on a CUDA host with mujoco_warp installed.
Training collection uses the real MuJoCo Menagerie RobotStudio SO-101 MJCF and an explicit engineering-guess Feetech/plastic-gripper physics profile.
Fixed eval remains the CPU MuJoCo SO-101 reach env and eval_cases.json, so approximate MJWarp collector parameters are treated as a train-time sim-to-real gap.
Reach success mirrors the SO101-Nexus ReachConfig default success_threshold=0.02 m, with targets sampled from a 0.15 m half-extent 3D workspace around the task center.
Episode horizon is 150 control steps so folded-start/camera-search policies have time to acquire and reach edge/corner fixed eval targets.
